name: Fruquintinib

fda.text: 5. WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS Hypertension: Control blood pressure prior to treatment and monitor during treatment. Manage with anti-hypertensive medications and adjustment of the dose of FRUZAQLA, if necessary. Withhold, dose reduce, or permanently discontinue based on severity of hypertension. ( 2.2 , 5.1 )…

examples.title: A Study of Fruquintinib in Combination With Tislelizumab in Advanced Solid Tumors
examples.why: At the time of study termination, both fruquintinib and tislelizumab are commercially available in the United States.

summary: Official warnings state that high blood pressure must be controlled before starting this drug and watched closely during treatment [3]. If high blood pressure happens, it may be managed with blood pressure medicines or by lowering the dose, pausing, or completely stopping the drug depending on how severe it is [3]. In addition, results from a small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave the drug a high risk score for the liver and a low risk score for the heart [M].
